role: Representative integrator, actual agent execution rather than human acceptance

authentication.scopeBoundary: Account-wide consent with no project selector. No project-restricted token is claimed. The disposable account discovers only the demonstration project.

outOfScopeProof.setupEvidence: Operator confirmed a real disposable project owned by a different transfer-source account with no memberships.
outOfScopeProof.meaning: JSON-RPC transport succeeded; project and issue tools denied object access. This is not an HTTP403 claim.

revocation.uiPath: Account settings → Minddy MCP → Disconnect → confirmation Disconnect

writes: Local OAuth client registration and grant, followed by actual UI grant revocation.
Normal application-tab metadata and local-snapshot persistence during settings navigation. No business-content write.
retainedFailures: Initial harness after token exchange treated fetch Response.status as a function. Corrected numeric property, then reinitialized with the same genuine token; no second grant or fabricated result.
Initial Disconnect only opened an alertdialog. Confirmation was then submitted, DELETE200 observed and revoked-token401 verified.
limitations: No AI/provider call, forge/content write, webhook delivery or desktop-client installation claimed.
